Run repository garbage collection as deploy, not root, because the repository and its Git config are developer-writable; preserve maintenance and releases.
Removed web billing account write privileges (payouts/export only read); restricted WordPress DB account to web host rather than whole office subnet.

Invoice adjustment now requires the requested amount to equal the referenced order amount, rather than merely accepting any amount for an existing order. Web billing account no longer has direct write access.
